note: the Number.isSafeInteger check is dropped, so sums past 2^53-1 lose precision silently. JavaScript has no integer type and never throws here, so the failure is a wrong number rather than a wrap or an exception. Same family as java-int-wrap, different observable. Verified: 'unsafe' -> 9007199254740992

check.probe: call `safeAdd(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, 2)`, a sum that lands past 2^53-1
check.watch: the `Number.isSafeInteger(sum)` check is gone, so check what the returned number actually is once the sum passes the safe-integer range
check.restored: `Number.isSafeInteger(sum)` is back before the return, so check that an unsafe sum reports itself instead of coming back as a rounded number
